title: Aqua Vista | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked in the tranquil Lakeside neighborhood of Blue Mountain Beach, Aqua Vista is a coastal retreat perfectly designed for families and groups of up to twelve. With a spacious main-floor master suite and four additional bedrooms upstairs, including a playful bunk room and a dedicated entertainment space for kids, this home offers the perfect balance of relaxation and togetherness. The open-concept living area and fully equipped kitchen provide ample room for everyone to gather, while the home's proximity to the community pool makes it easy to cool off just steps from the door. A convenient walking path to the beach across the street ensures effortless access to the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of 30A. Blue Mountain Beach is celebrated for its laid-back charm, natural beauty, and family-friendly atmosphere. Guests can start their day with a fresh pastry from Blue Mountain Bakery, explore the scenic walking and biking trails, or paddle along the pristine shoreline. Evenings come alive with vibrant dining options like Blue Mabel and Red Fish Taco, capped off with a sweet treat from the beloved Blue Mountain Creamery. Located near Redfish Village's quaint boutiques and dining, Aqua Vista is a gateway to the best of 30A living, where every moment feels like a blend of comfort, luxury, and coastal adventure.
